builder.setup_create_title: Create a knowledge base through conversation

ingest.title: Ingest sources
ingest.description: Start a knowledge base job and hand issues, chats, uploaded files or web pages to an agent. It writes the knowledge into pages and cites a source for every fact.

review.title: Takes effect after review
review.description: An agent's changes go into a draft first. You review it and submit it; it takes effect once the knowledge base creator or an owner or admin merges it.

read.title: Read and annotate
read.description: When something is wrong or outdated, select the sentence and add an annotation. Annotations can be handed to an agent in one click.

maintain.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintain.description: Set up a scheduled ingest and a scheduled health check, and the knowledge base keeps up with the latest issues and code.

annotation.compose_hint: Agents see this sentence when they handle it

ingest.title: Ingest sources
ingest.description: Read issues, chats or web pages and write the knowledge into pages

health.title: Health check
health.description: Find stale pages, contradictions, orphan pages and claims whose code changed

merge.title: Merge duplicates
merge.description: Find pages that repeat each other and merge them into one

annotations.title: Handle annotations
annotations.description: Change pages as the pending annotations ask

schedule_ingest.title: Schedule ingestion
schedule_ingest.description: Create an automation that ingests the day's issues, comments and chats

schedule_health.title: Schedule a health check
schedule_health.description: Create an automation that runs a health check every week
